units.source_text: 男人想把尴尬局面支吾过去，掸掉身上的沙，下到了泥地间。

en.t: The man tried to bluff his way past the awkward situation, brushed the sand from his body, and climbed down onto the patch of muddy ground.

units.source_text: 绞一把湿手巾给女人擦把脸吧？

en.t: Why not wring out a wet towel and wipe the woman's face with it?

units.source_text: 比起不停地流汗，这样做更符合道理。

en.t: Compared with sweating endlessly, that made far more sense.

units.source_text: 有人说，文明的高低，和人的皮肤清洁度成正比例。

en.t: Some people say that the level of civilization is directly proportional to the cleanliness of people's skin.

units.source_text: 人假如真有灵魂，恐怕那灵魂就在皮肤里。

en.t: If human beings truly have souls, perhaps those souls are in the skin.

units.source_text: 只要想一想水，肮脏的皮肤就成了几万个吸盘。

en.t: The moment he so much as thought of water, his filthy skin became tens of thousands of suction cups.

units.source_text: 像冰一样清冷透明，又像羽毛般柔软，这灵魂的绷带……

en.t: Clear, cold, and transparent as ice, yet soft as a feather, this bandage of the soul...

units.source_text: 再晚一分钟，全身的皮肤都会扑簌簌地烂掉，掉下来吧。

en.t: If it were even one minute later, the skin all over his body would surely rot away and fall off in flakes.
